_what_this_is: ARCHITECTURE BASELINE v1.0, frozen 2026-09-17. It pins STRUCTURAL FACTS so that a later architectural change is a RECORDED REVISION rather than informal evolution. It is not a description: docs/enterprise-diligence/TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE_BRIEF.md describes the architecture and controls that role. It is not an authoritative register and creates no content; every value here is COPIED from the artifact named beside it, and where this file and that artifact disagree, THE ARTIFACT CONTROLS.
_why_a_freeze: Nothing in this repository could previously detect that the architecture had changed. The guard suite detects drift in claims, projections, retention units and vocabulary; it did not detect a change in the SHAPE of the estate. check_architecture_baseline_is_current fails when any pinned fact moves, which forces the change to be acknowledged rather than absorbed.
